text:
elaine: Quick sync 1: planning the next design-partner wave. Need to lock in: synchronous vs async track, light SLA, and onboarding checklist. Thoughts?

sami: prefer optional syncs. Short, focused, max 30m. Keep async as primary channel.

juan: agree on short meetings. Also need to know expected response SLAs for engineering. We can't promise full SRE-level uptime for every DP.

elaine: draft proposal:
- Tracks: Async-only (default) or Synchronous (opt-in).
- Synchronous commitment: 30m/week for first 4 weeks, then 30m every other week for duration of pilot.
- Qualifier for sync track: complete the integration checklist + run a 5-min smoke test in our staging environment.
- No-show rule: 2 missed syncs -> downgrade to async-only, still included in bug triage.
- Engineering SLA while in active sync: acknowledge triage within 24h, target fix or mitigation plan for DP-blocking bugs within 72h.

marie: success metrics suggestion: activation (>=2 meaningful API calls in first 7 days), feedback NPS (post-sync avg >= 4), and time-to-first-fix for DP-blocking issues.

juan: 72h fix target is more realistic. Also propose we define "DP-blocking" precisely: prevents automation, breaks core flow, or causes data loss.

elaine: agreed. We'll document DP-blocking definition in onboarding. Also propose a rotating engineering buddy system for the 4-week intensive onboarding to cover quick turnarounds.

sami: onboarding kit for sync track should include: 1) Integration checklist (env, auth, model pinning), 2) Quickstart snippet for the SDK, 3) Meeting agenda template, and 4) a minimal observability runbook (where to find logs, how to flag regressions). I'll draft the kit.

marie: post-sync survey (one question + optional comment): "How useful was this sync? (1-5). Any regressions? (Y/N). Top request:" Attach optional logs or prompt examples. I'll own collection and weekly rollups.

elaine: ops-bot, can you create a GH label for DP regressions and a lightweight workflow to auto-create an issue when a DP flags something via our intake form? Also create a thread template in Slack that ops can clone per-DP.

ops-bot: done. Created label `dp-regression` in product repo. Example workflow: ```yaml
on: issues
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: notify dp regression
        if: contains(join(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, ','), 'dp-regression')
        run: echo "DP regression flagged - pinging rotation"
```

juan: recommend also auto-posting a short summary into the per-DP Slack thread when an issue is created so the DP sees progress.

elaine: good idea. ops-bot, add a step to post a one-line summary to the DP thread when label is attached.

ops-bot: added a webhook step. Template message: "DP <name> flagged regression: <issue link>. Rotation notified."

elaine: final ops + product actions:
- sami: deliver onboarding kit + agenda template (48h)
- juan: confirm rotation schedule & names for 4-week onboarding (48h)
- marie: share survey schema + reporting dashboard spec (72h)
- ops-bot: create Slack thread template + GH workflow + webhook (24h)

elaine: unless objections, I'll add these items to the DP pilot ops doc and start scheduling invites. If anyone has strong concerns about the SLA or cadence, speak up now, otherwise moving forward. :wave:
